bills.title: Social Services and Other Legislation Amendment (Lifting the Income Limit for the Commonwealth Seniors Health Card) Bill 2022

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2022-10-26.189.1): > *That the committee does not insist on its amendments to which the House of Representatives has disagreed.* The House of Representatives had previously [disagreed with several amendments](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/representatives/2022-10-26/1) proposed by the Senate. By not insisting on the amendments, the Senate has agreed to pass the bill without them. This means the bill can now [become part of our law](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/).
